about: Every user interaction in 8d87cd2's ui/ modules. `old` runs on 8d87cd2 from the demo with the tour closed; `new` is how to reach it from the new UI's default views, empty where none was found; `bench: true` lets the runner also try `old` inside More > Timeline and panels. See tests/parity/run.mjs.
